nodeMajorHint: LTS often 20 or 22; align with project runtime
installPm2Desc: One-click npm install -g pm2 (process manager). Requires Node.js first.
pm2InstallHint: Runs npm -g as root with system-change rights; projects can use PM2 deploy after install.
pm2ReadyHint: PM2 is on PATH; projects can use PM2 process mode.
versionAlreadyInstalled: Version {{version}} is already on the host
phpInstallHint: Needs system-change rights and admin; pick common extensions (package names vary by version: php8.2-mysql, php8.3-gd…)
phpExtHint: Choose extensions to install. Each PHP version maps to different apt packages (php8.2-mysql ≠ php8.3-mysql). GD is the old “gd2”.
phpExtSelectHint: Packages install as php{{version}}-…; FPM/CLI core is always included; already installed are hidden from selection
pluginsSelectHint: Select to install with the runtime (e.g. PM2 for Node, Poetry for Python)
pluginsInstallNote: Select tools then Install selected. First-time runtime install can include tools; if runtime is present, only use the button above.
remoteNewerHint: Installed {{current}} · upstream latest {{remote}} (install targets follow the version list)
globalPhpIniDesc: One setting per row. After write you can Apply to system or inject via project deploy
advancedExtraDesc: Directives not in catalog; one key=value per line; raw appends to ini tail
extraDirectivesHint: One key=value per line (keys not already above)
rawAppend: Append raw to end of ini
demoVhostDesc: Advanced/debug; daily sites use Projects → Deploy
poolNameHint: Hand-typed id (demo); project paths use ysks_* users
enableReloadHint: Needs system-change rights; off = write management only
composerToolsDesc: Live probe of PATH tools and php -m (read-only)
installHint: Needs system-change rights and admin; installing toolchain ≠ project is public
panelTuneDesc: Write management; inject env on deploy
envPreviewDesc: Merged result after save / last load
nodeDetectedHint: Node detected on host; reinstall follows privileges and may overwrite.
nodeProbeAfter: After install, Re-probe to confirm PATH and version.
phpIniSteps1: Design global values on the php.ini tab and save
phpIniSteps2: Optional: Apply to system (writes /etc/php/…/conf.d, needs root)
phpIniSteps3: Project deploy injects merged ini as php_admin_* on the FPM pool
phpIniSteps4: Projects can override individual keys (Project → Deploy)
phpIniNote: Changes save to panel dataDir first; Apply to system copies to /etc/php and reloads FPM. Project pools inject php_admin_value on deploy.
phpIniEmpty: Empty catalog — reload or ensure API is up.
prodPathDesc: : create PHP project → deploy/apply FPM (pool = project Linux user + isolated home). This page is
demoNotBind: (hand-typed pool name) and does not auto-bind project isolation. Global php.ini is on the php.ini tab.
applyOkWritten: Apply success = files written. Prefer project deploy so User=project Linux user.
pressReprobeHost: Press Re-probe to load host version matrix
installScriptNote: Writes install script; runs only with privileges. Tuning is on the Tuning tab; redeploy projects for process changes.
envNote: Node: max-old-space-size merges into NODE_OPTIONS. Go/Python/Rust use official env vars.

post_max_size.label: Max POST size

open_basedir.label: open_basedir path restriction

disable_functions.label: Disabled functions

pluginsInstalledHint: Detected on PATH; excluded from install selection. Uninstall is best-effort.
pluginsAllInstalled: All catalog tools are already on this host.
pluginUninstallConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from this host (via npm/apt/pip as applicable). Stop services that depend on it first.
phpExtUninstallHint: Uninstall optional extensions (apt remove; never FPM/CLI)
phpExtUninstallConfirm: Will apt remove “{{pkg}}” ({{name}}). Core FPM/CLI is never removed.
addonsInstallAbove: Use “Install selected…” above for tools/extensions. This button only installs/confirms the runtime version.
phpExtInstallNote: Select extensions then Install selected. First-time PHP uses Install PHP below (core+ext); when installed only the extensions button is shown.
phpExtInstallNoteInstalled: Select extensions then Install selected. This version is already on the host — no runtime reinstall.
phpExtInstallNoteFirst: PHP {{version}} is not installed: select extensions then use Install PHP {{version}} below (one install button, core+extensions).
switchDefaultHint: This version is installed but not the active default. Switch without reinstalling; other versions stay on disk.
multiVersionHint: Go/Rust keep multiple versions: Install missing ones, then Switch default for PATH.

pm2.title: PM2 fleet
pm2.desc: Read-only view of pm2 jlist (panel user PM2_HOME). Live SSE refreshes every 2s.
pm2.emptyDesc: Install the pm2 plugin for Node, then refresh.
pm2.noAppsDesc: No PM2 apps for the panel user. Projects usually use systemd (see YSK list above).
pm2.streamLogDesc: One line per SSE tick (not process stdout).
pm2.projectsDesc: systemd units for panel projects (default deploy path — not PM2).
pm2.noProjectsDesc: No node/bun projects in the panel, or OS user not provisioned.
pm2.pm2OnlyDesc: Only apps started with PM2 under the panel user. systemd deploys appear above.
